title: Concept: Build flags that trade safety for speed
description: .cargo/config.toml declares a rustflag that changes code generation for the whole workspace, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: A verification or locking control is switched off, so the integrity guarantees the ecosystem offers are not applied here.
